title: Loans; insurance and guarantees.
bodyText: The corporation may procure insurance or guarantees against any default of its loans, in amounts and from insurers or guarantors, as it deems necessary or desirable.
bodyHtml: [§201H-109]  Loans; insurance and guarantees.  The corporation may procure insurance or guarantees against any default of its loans, in amounts and from insurers or guarantors, as it deems necessary or desirable. [L 2006, c 180, pt of §4]
